final: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN m.molecule_id END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) * 100.0 as percentage FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#'
